title: University Project about ai tools in game dev. All Help is appreciated
author: Ambitious-Ad2986
selftext: Hello, We’re a group of students at the IT University in Copenhagen, Denmark, and as part of our current semester, we are asked to conduct a small qualitative study about AI tools in indie game development. We are interested in games with the “AI” tag and thought some of you might be able to provide a unique perspective to our project. If you have previously released or are currently working on a game using AI tools, you may just be the person we want to talk to! We would like to conduct an interview with you, which shouldn’t take more than around 30 minutes. Ideally, on a call on Discord, Teams, Zoom, or whatever works for you. Otherwise, we would also be happy with a written interview or similar. Hope to hear back from you soon! Regards, Louie and Martin, students at the IT University of Denmark Contact me here or by email: lofo@itu.dk mrip@itu.dk
